# v1.7.0 — Halftone Pattern

**Latest version**

### New Features

- Added **[Halftone Pattern](/env/shader/halftone/)**: shading drawn as dots, lines, cross-hatch or your own pattern texture, the same feature as in ZLZ Anime Shader
- **World** space keeps the pattern unbroken across floors, walls and props
- **Shadow Sources** choose which shadows get ink: Form, Cast and Baked, each with its own Ink weight
